spans.s:
भोज, i. e. भुज् + अ, m.
 1. A cowherd.
 2. The name of a country.
 3. The name of a king, Johns.

भोजन, i. e. 2. भुज् + अन, n.
 1. Enjoying, Pañc. 61, 22.
 2. Eating, Pañc. 245, 22.
 3. Food, Pañc. 138, 2.
 --Comp.
भोजस्, i. e. 2. भुज् + अस् in विश्व-, adj. Yielding all the enjoyments,
भोजिन्, i. e. 2. भुज् + इन्, adj. One who eats,
भोज्य + ता (vb. 2. भुज्), f. Condition of being eaten, Pañc. 193, 21.
+ व्यय भोजन- + व्यय, m. expense for food,
